user.title: Connect to a SONOFF CAM-S2
user.description: Enter the camera's IP address and its local admin password (the one used to log in to the camera's own web console).

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the camera.
data_description.password: Leave empty only if the camera has no login password set.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate SONOFF CAM-S2
reauth_confirm.description: Authentication failed. Enter the camera's local admin password again.

dhcp.title: SONOFF CAM-S2 discovered
dhcp.description: A SONOFF camera was found on your network.

dhcp_confirm.title: Confirm the discovered camera
dhcp_confirm.description: Enter the local admin password to finish setting up the discovered camera.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the camera. Check the host and that the camera is powered on.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid password. The RTSP password is not accepted here - use the camera's local admin password.
error.password_required: This camera requires the local admin password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while talking to the camera.

abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the camera.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the camera for status.
data_description.enable_onvif_motion: Subscribe to the camera's ONVIF service for real-time motion and person detection. Requires the RTSP credentials, which are read automatically.
